source.title: Schedule-Rates-for-Motorcar
notes: Official Insurance Commission motorcar tariff schedule.
CTPL premiums include taxes as indicated in the source.
Voluntary third-party liability tables are present in the PDF but are not encoded yet because the OCR text dump is too noisy to trust without visual verification.

ownDamageAndTheft.sourceText: Private car own damage and theft

notes: Min of PHP 2,000 or 0.5% of sum insured, whichever is higher.

surcharges: 20% surcharge for racing, pacemaking, reliability trial, or speed testing.
notes: Vehicles with dual-purpose bodies should be rated under the private car tariff with a private car policy added.
Min of PHP 3,000 or 1.0% of sum insured, whichever is higher.

loadingRules: 20% surcharge for hauling logs, lumber, sand, gravel, bottled beverages, gasoline products, and/or other inflammable articles or materials.
Loading can be up to 100% for vehicles over 3 years old and 125% for vehicles 1 to 3 years old.
Dual-purpose bodies should be rated under the private car tariff with a private car policy added.

ownDamageAndTheft.label: AC, PUJ, taxi, and tourist car

notes: Min of PHP 4,000 or 1.25% of sum insured, whichever is higher.
Min of PHP 500 or 1.0% of sum insured, whichever is higher.

ctpl.label: Private Cars (including jeeps and utility vehicles)
Light/medium trucks (own goods) not over 3,930 kgs
Heavy trucks (own goods) and private buses over 3,930 kgs
